# Beta Gadgets Refund Policy

## Eligibility window

Beta Gadgets accepts refund requests within 30 calendar days of delivery -
double Acme Widgets' window - because Beta's gadgets are higher-cost items
customers often want to trial for a full month before committing.

## Refund timelines

Approved Beta Gadgets refunds post to the original payment method within
3 business days of the warehouse confirming receipt, faster than the
industry norm because Beta pre-authorizes refunds the moment a return
label is scanned by the carrier, not when it reaches the warehouse.

## Restocking fees

Beta Gadgets charges no restocking fee on any refund, regardless of
reason - this is a deliberate differentiator from competitors and should
never be mentioned as a fee to a Beta Gadgets customer.
